body.zh-Hant: 霍奇斯1887年生於喬治亞州的佩里。他在西點軍校讀了兩年，1906年改以列兵身分入伍，1909年升為少尉。
body.en: Hodges was born in Perry, Georgia, in 1887. He attended West Point for two years, enlisted as a private in 1906, and became a second lieutenant in 1909.

heading.zh-Hant: 兩次大戰之間與擔任軍長

body.zh-Hant: 一戰時他在法國隨步兵作戰。戰間期他曾任步兵學校校長，任期自1940年10月7日至1941年3月3日；其後任步兵署長，自1941年5月30日至1942年3月9日。1942年5月12日第十軍司令部在聖安東尼奧成立，他出任軍長，直到1943年2月。
body.en: He served with the infantry in France in the First World War. He was Commandant of the Infantry School from 7 October 1940 to 3 March 1941, then Chief of Infantry from 30 May 1941 to 9 March 1942. The 10th Corps HQ was formed at San Antonio on 12 May 1942 and he commanded it until February 1943.

heading.zh-Hant: 第三集團軍與布萊德雷副手
heading.en: Third Army and deputy to Bradley

body.zh-Hant: 1943年2月他晉升中將，統率第三集團軍司令部與南方防衛司令部。第三集團軍1944年1月改由巴頓指揮，霍奇斯轉任布萊德雷的副手；原定計畫是布萊德雷升任第12集團軍群司令後，由他接掌第一集團軍。
body.en: In February 1943 he was promoted to lieutenant general and commanded the 3rd Army HQ and the Southern Defense Command. He was replaced as its commander by Patton in January 1944 and appointed Bradley’s deputy; the plan was that he would replace Bradley at the 1st Army once Bradley took the 12th Army Group.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一集團軍：法國至亞琛與許特根森林
heading.en: First Army in France, Aachen and the Hürtgen Forest

body.zh-Hant: 1944年8月1日，霍奇斯接掌第一集團軍。他的部隊橫越法國北部，是最先進入巴黎的部隊，並參與攻占亞琛；對魯爾河水壩的進攻則把美軍帶進許特根森林，那是大戰中較具爭議的戰役之一。
body.en: After taking command of the 1st Army on 1 August 1944, Hodges advanced across northern France; his troops were the first to enter Paris, and his army took part in the capture of Aachen. The attack towards the Roer River dams took US troops into the Hurtgen Forest, one of the more controversial battles of the war.

heading.zh-Hant: 阿登反攻、渡萊茵河與戰後
heading.en: Ardennes, the Rhine and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 德軍阿登攻勢使霍奇斯措手不及；12月17日他要求投入兩個空降師，12月20日他的集團軍與第九集團軍一併改歸蒙哥馬利指揮。戰事結束後，他的部隊在雷馬根渡過萊茵河，1945年3月在易北河與蘇軍會師。他後來晉升四星上將，直到1949年退役一直擔任第一集團軍司令。
body.en: Hodges was caught out by the German Ardennes offensive. On 17 December he asked for the two airborne divisions to be committed, and on 20 December his army and the Ninth Army were placed under Montgomery. His army crossed the Rhine at Remagen and met the Soviets in March 1945. He was promoted to full general and remained First Army commander until his retirement in 1949.

body.zh-Hant: 埃克一戰時以步兵身分入伍，後轉入航空勤務隊成為飛行員。他在1927年領導泛美友好飛行並獲麥凱獎；兩年後駕駛「問號」號完成空中加油續航飛行，隔年又完成第一次全程依儀表的不著陸橫越美國飛行。
body.en: Eaker joined the Army in World War I as an infantryman and soon transferred to the Air Service and became a pilot. He led the Pan American Goodwill Flight in 1927, winning the Mackay Trophy, two years later piloted the Question Mark air-refueling flight, and the following year made the first nonstop transcontinental flight entirely on instruments.

heading.zh-Hant: 第八航空軍司令與卡薩布蘭卡會議
heading.en: Commander of the Eighth Air Force and Casablanca

body.zh-Hant: 1942年8月17日，埃克親自搭機參加第八航空軍對占領歐洲的首次重型轟炸機空襲；同年12月，他出任駐英第八航空軍司令。阿諾德派他赴英的用意，是要他把戰鬥機飛行員的精神灌輸給轟炸機組員。1943年1月卡薩布蘭卡會議上，他向邱吉爾力陳「晝夜不停」轟炸德國，說服了邱吉爾。
body.en: On 17 August 1942 Eaker flew on the Eighth’s first heavy-bomber raid on occupied Europe, and in December 1942 he became commander of the Eighth Air Force in England. Arnold sent him to instil a fighter pilot spirit in the bomber crews. At the Casablanca Conference in January 1943 he pleaded for “around the clock bombing” of Germany and convinced Churchill.

It was in December 1942 that he became commander of the Eighth

heading.zh-Hant: 施韋因富特與雷根斯堡轟炸戰役
heading.en: The Schweinfurt and Regensburg bombing battles

body.zh-Hant: 在施韋因富特與雷根斯堡轟炸戰役中，1943年8月17日埃克派兩支編隊轟炸施韋因富特與雷根斯堡，其中一支轉降北非；施韋因富特一役有60架飛機被擊落，占攻擊兵力兩成。10月他仍決定派轟炸機再襲施韋因富特，格蘭特稱這是他的「平反」。
body.en: On 17 August 1943 Eaker sent two formations of bombers to Schweinfurt and Regensburg, one of which shuttled on to North Africa. The Schweinfurt mission lost 60 aircraft, 20 percent of the attacking force. He sent bombers back for a second raid in October 1943, which Grant calls his vindication.

heading.en: Mediterranean command and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 1943年12月19日一份電報暫定由埃克接掌地中海盟軍空軍，他自己認為這是「明升暗降」；來源另寫，他在地中海指揮義大利攻勢的空中支援，並與狄托的游擊隊聯絡。1945年3月馬歇爾召他回華盛頓出任阿諾德的副手。他1947年退役，1985年雷根總統將他晉升為四星上將。
body.en: A cable on 19 December (1943) tentatively designated Eaker to command the Allied Air Forces in the Mediterranean, a move he considered a “kick upstairs”. In the Mediterranean he directed air support for the offensives in Italy and set up liaisons with Tito’s partisans. In March 1945 Marshall called him back to Washington as Arnold’s deputy; he retired in 1947 and in 1985 President Reagan promoted him to four-star rank.

body.zh-Hant: 格羅夫斯1896年8月17日生於紐約州奧爾巴尼，不久後父親成為陸軍隨軍牧師，他在各處陸軍駐地長大。他先在華盛頓大學與麻省理工學院讀工程，1916年進入西點軍校，1918年以第四名畢業，加入陸軍工兵部隊。
body.en: Groves was born in Albany, New York, on 17 August 1896, shortly before his father became an Army chaplain, and grew up on Army posts. After studying engineering at the University of Washington and MIT he entered West Point in 1916, graduated fourth in his class in 1918 and joined the Army Corps of Engineers.

heading.en: Pentagon and Corps of Engineers posts

body.zh-Hant: 1940年代初，格羅夫斯在華盛頓擔任多種職務，其中最著名的是監督五角大廈的興建。他後來被任命為陸軍副建設主任；美國參戰後他期望到海外任戰鬥職務，卻被派去指揮曼哈頓工程區。
body.en: In the early 1940s Groves served in various capacities in Washington, most notably supervising the construction of the Pentagon. He became the Army’s Deputy Chief of Construction, and although he hoped for a combat assignment overseas after the United States entered the war, he was instead ordered to take command of the Manhattan Engineer District.

body.zh-Hant: 1942年9月17日，格羅夫斯受命主持曼哈頓工程區，9月23日獲任准將。隔天他買進鈾礦，9月19日又核可田納西州橡樹嶺為「X廠址」；10月中旬他與杜邦簽約並挑選歐本海默主持計畫Y，11月25日核可洛斯阿拉莫斯，1943年1月16日核可華盛頓州漢福德為鈽生產基地。
body.en: Groves was appointed head of the Manhattan Engineer District on 17 September 1942 and made brigadier general on 23 September. He acquired uranium ore the next day, approved Oak Ridge as Site X on 19 September, chose Oppenheimer to lead Project Y, approved Los Alamos on 25 November 1942, and on 16 January 1943 approved Hanford, Washington for plutonium production.

body.zh-Hant: 杜立德1896年生於加州阿拉米達，1917年10月以飛行學員身分入伍，1918年3月11日獲任信號兵團航空組少尉。1920年7月1日取得正規軍職，1922年9月完成第一次橫越美國的飛行；他後來在麻省理工學院取得碩士與航空科學博士。
body.en: Doolittle was born in Alameda, California, in 1896, enlisted as a flying cadet in October 1917 and was commissioned a second lieutenant in the Signal Corps Aviation Section on 11 March 1918. He received a regular commission on 1 July 1920, made his first cross-country flight in September 1922, and later earned a master’s degree and doctorate at MIT.

body.en: Doolittle resigned his regular commission on 15 February 1930 and managed the Aviation Department of Shell Oil. body.zh-Hant: 1942年4月18日，16架B-25中型轟炸機從大黃蜂號航空母艦起飛，目標包括東京、名古屋、神戶與大阪。杜立德親駕第一架，上午8時20分起飛，中午12時25分抵東京投彈；所有16架都在中國降落或墜毀，或轉降蘇聯。他在中國期間被越級晉升為准將，並獲頒榮譽勳章。
body.en: On 18 April 1942, 16 B-25 bombers launched from the carrier Hornet to strike Tokyo, Nagoya, Kobe and Osaka. Doolittle took off at 8:20 a.m. in the first B-25 and dropped his bombs on Tokyo at 12:25 p.m.; all 16 aircraft reached China or crashed there, or diverted to the Soviet Union. He was promoted to brigadier general while still in China and received the Medal of Honor.

heading.en: Air force commands: Twelfth, NASAF, Fifteenth and Eighth

body.zh-Hant: 1942年7月，已升准將的杜立德被派往第八航空軍，9月出任北非第12航空軍司令，11月晉升少將，1943年3月起任北非戰略空軍司令；同年11月接掌地中海戰區的第15航空軍，自1944年1月起到1945年9月指揮第8航空軍，1944年3月13日升中將。
body.en: In July 1942 Doolittle, by then a brigadier general, was assigned to the Eighth Air Force and in September became commanding general of the Twelfth Air Force in North Africa. He was promoted to major general in November and in March 1943 took the North African Strategic Air Forces. He took the Fifteenth Air Force in November and from January 1944 to September 1945 commanded the Eighth Air Force, becoming a lieutenant general on 13 March 1944.

body.zh-Hant: 1946年5月10日杜立德轉入非現役預備役，回殼牌石油任副總裁。1951年3月他擔任空軍參謀長的特別助理；1959年2月28日退出空軍職務；1985年4月4日國會將他晉升為空軍退役名單上的上將。
body.en: On 10 May 1946 Doolittle went to inactive reserve status and returned to Shell Oil as a vice president. In March 1951 he became special assistant to the Air Force chief of staff, retired from Air Force duty on 28 February 1959, and on 4 April 1985 Congress advanced him to full general on the retired list.

body.zh-Hant: 斯普魯恩斯1886年生於馬里蘭州巴爾的摩，1906年畢業於海軍官校，隨後多在驅逐艦服役。他曾指揮戰艦密西西比號，也擔任過海軍作戰學院與情報、參謀方面的職務。
body.en: Spruance was born in Baltimore in 1886 and graduated from the Naval Academy in 1906. He remained in destroyers between the wars and later captained the battleship Mississippi, also serving at the Naval War College and in intelligence and staff postings.

citations.quote: Raymond A. Spruance was born in Baltimore, Maryland, on 3 July 1886.
He graduated from the U.S. Naval Academy in 1906
Spruance remained in destroyers between the world wars
serving as captain of the battleship Mississippi (BB-41)
He also served at the Naval War College and in intelligence and staff postings.

body.zh-Hant: 1940至1941年間，他指揮第十海軍區與加勒比海岸防衛區。太平洋戰爭初期他指揮一個巡洋艦分艦隊，1942年6月初在中途島海戰中率領擁有兩艘航空母艦的第16特遣艦隊。弗萊徹的約克鎮號重創後，弗萊徹把艦隊指揮權交給他，因此飛龍號被毀的功勞可歸於他。
body.en: In 1940-41 he commanded the Tenth Naval District and Caribbean Sea Frontier. In the first months of the Pacific war he commanded a cruiser division, and in early June 1942 he led Task Force 16, with two carriers, at Midway. After Yorktown was badly damaged, Fletcher handed command of the fleet to Spruance, who can claim credit for the destruction of Hiryu.

body.zh-Hant: 1942年6月18日他出任尼米茲的參謀長，1943年6月19日晉升中將並成為尼米茲的副手，8月5日轉任中太平洋部隊司令，該部隊1943年9月改稱第五艦隊。他先後指揮吉爾伯特群島戰役（1943年11月20日在馬金與塔拉瓦登陸）及馬紹爾群島戰役，並於1944年2月21日晉升上將。
body.en: On 18 June 1942 he became Nimitz’s chief of staff; on 19 June 1943 he was promoted to vice admiral and became Nimitz’s deputy, and on 5 August he became Commander, Central Pacific Force, renamed the Fifth Fleet in September 1943. He directed the Gilberts campaign (landings on Makin and Tarawa on 20 November 1943) and the Marshalls campaign, and was promoted to full admiral on 21 February 1944.

heading.zh-Hant: 菲律賓海海戰、硫磺島與沖繩
heading.en: Philippine Sea, Iwo Jima and Okinawa

body.zh-Hant: 1944年6月19至21日的菲律賓海海戰中，美軍擊沉翔鶴、大鳳、飛鷹三艘航空母艦，並擊落約300架日機，史稱「馬里亞納火雞大獵殺」；斯普魯恩斯因未能趁機殲滅日本艦隊而受批評。他其後指揮第五艦隊進攻硫磺島（1945年2月19日）與沖繩（1945年4月1日）。
body.en: In the Battle of the Philippine Sea of 19-21 June 1944 the Americans sank three Japanese carriers (Shokaku, Taiho and Hiyo) and shot down around 300 aircraft, the “Great Marianas Turkey Shoot”, although Spruance was much criticised for failing to destroy the Japanese fleet. He later commanded the Fifth Fleet for the invasions of Iwo Jima (19 February 1945) and Okinawa (1 April 1945).

body.zh-Hant: 1945年11月24日他接替尼米茲出任太平洋艦隊總司令，任期不長；1946年3月1日起擔任海軍作戰學院院長，至1948年6月30日。他於次日退役，1952至1955年出任駐菲律賓大使。
body.en: On 24 November 1945 he replaced Nimitz as commander-in-chief of the Pacific Fleet, holding the post briefly; from 1 March 1946 to 30 June 1948 he was president of the Naval War College. He retired the next day and served as ambassador to the Philippines in 1952-55.
